metadata.title: Linux server and desktop data review
metadata.description: Review known Linux locations for container and VM disks, database clusters, certificates, keyrings, system journals and desktop app profiles. Most of this data cannot be regenerated.

insights.title: Review Ollama system models
insights.subject: model weights
insights.detail: Models pulled by the system Ollama service. Re-pulling costs time and bandwidth. Use the ollama list and ollama rm commands rather than deleting files.

insights.title: Review Docker Engine data
insights.subject: container data
insights.detail: Docker's data root: images, containers, volumes and build cache. Named volumes can hold database data. Use docker system df and the Docker CLI before any change.

insights.title: Review Podman storage
insights.subject: container data
insights.detail: Rootful Podman images, containers and volumes. Use podman system df and the Podman CLI for changes.

insights.title: Review libvirt VM images
insights.subject: VM disk
insights.detail: Disk images of libvirt virtual machines, often very large. Remove guests with virsh or virt-manager; a disk still attached to a guest breaks it.

insights.title: Review PostgreSQL data
insights.subject: database
insights.detail: PostgreSQL cluster data on Debian-style installs. Stop the service and back up with pg_dump or your backup tool before any change.

insights.title: Review MySQL data
insights.subject: database
insights.detail: MySQL and MariaDB data directory. Stop the service and back up with mysqldump or your backup tool before any change.

insights.title: Review MongoDB data
insights.subject: database
insights.detail: MongoDB data files on package-based installs. Back up with mongodump or your backup tool before any change.

insights.title: Review Let's Encrypt configuration
insights.subject: certificates
insights.detail: Certbot keeps certificates, private keys and renewal settings in archive, live and renewal folders. Removing parts breaks renewal; use certbot certificates and certbot's own commands.

insights.title: Review systemd journal
insights.subject: system logs
insights.detail: Persistent systemd journal. Use journalctl for its supported size and time controls; editing journal files directly is not supported.

insights.title: Review GNOME keyring files
insights.subject: keyring
insights.detail: Keyring files that hold passwords saved by GNOME apps. Removing a keyring loses the secrets in it; back up before any change.

insights.title: Review Firefox profiles
insights.subject: browser profile
insights.detail: Profiles hold bookmarks, saved logins, extensions and sessions. Use Firefox's clear-data settings for cache; export what you need before removing a profile.

insights.title: Review Chrome user data
insights.subject: browser profile
insights.detail: Profiles hold bookmarks, saved passwords, extensions and history. Use Chrome's Delete browsing data for cache, and check sync before removing a profile.

insights.title: Review Signal messages
insights.subject: message store
insights.detail: Encrypted message database and attachments. Signal cannot restore messages without this data. Use Signal's backup and export options before any change.

insights.title: Review Thunderbird profiles
insights.subject: mail profile
insights.detail: Mail, address books and account settings. Local folders can hold mail that exists nowhere else. Back up the profile before any change.
